records.title: New Railway Line between Guwahati-Tezpur
details:
a to d: Final Location Survey (FLS) of Agthori (Guwahati) - Dekargaon (Tezpur) New Line Project (155 Km) and Tezpur – Silghat New Line Project (25 Km), which
pass through Darrang and Sonitpur districts have been sanctioned and survey work has been taken up.
